verdict.rationale: Fly.io's official CLI ships `fly launch`, documented to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application from the project source directory in one command. The getting-started docs present it as the primary workflow. Community reports of flaky deploys concern platform reliability, not whether the single-command launch exists, so they lower confidence rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: generating project source code from a template (it works on an existing source directory), coverage of the apps it does not auto-deploy ("for most apps"), and independent hands-on corroboration of a smooth one-command launch.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
